name: section
description: status: deprecated (RFC-042 Change B, srs#559) - superseded by the concept/mechanism tree (contains/precedes); retained only for the 10 existing section records until they are retyped or split, then removed per rfc-decision-5f8204bc (deprecate-then-remove). A top-level numbered section of a specification. Ordering is determined by section-sequence relations, not by section number embedded in the title.
